stimulus.teks: Text: Mangroves, the team argues, buy time; they do not reverse land subsidence. Villages that restore the forest but continue pumping from deep wells are protecting a coast that is still sinking.

soal: In the text, the phrase buy time is closest in meaning to ...

pilihan.teks: delay serious harm long enough for other measures to work
make the restoration project more expensive
measure how quickly the ground is sinking
replace the need for industrial water supply

pembahasan.inti: The contrast with reverse land subsidence shows that buying time means postponing damage rather than removing its cause.
langkah: Read the clause that follows: buy time is set against reverse, so the phrase concerns postponement rather than cure.
Check the closing sentence about villages that keep pumping, which shows the delay is meant to allow other measures.
Match this to option B and reject A because no purchase of land is involved.
pembahasan.jebakan: Option A takes buy literally as a commercial transaction, which the metaphorical context rules out.
pembahasan.cepat: Idioms in context are defined by their contrast partner in the same sentence.

stimulus.teks: Reviewers described the report as superficial: it repeated familiar claims, offered no measurement, and never examined the data it cited.

soal: In the sentence, the word superficial is closest in meaning to ...

pembahasan.inti: The colon introduces evidence that defines the word: repeated claims, no measurement, and no examination of data all point to a lack of depth.
langkah: Read the clues after the colon as a definition of the word in context.
Repeated claims and absent measurement describe work that stays on the surface rather than going into detail.
Among the options, only lacking depth matches that description.
pembahasan.jebakan: Option B is the opposite of the evidence, and option C confuses length with depth.
pembahasan.cepat: When a colon follows a judgement word, the list after it is the definition.

stimulus.teks: The committee met for three hours but could not ___ a decision, so the proposal was postponed to the next session.

soal: Which word completes the sentence with the correct collocation?

pembahasan.inti: English pairs decision with reach or make, not with arrive, take, or do; the context of a committee meeting points to reach.
langkah: Identify the noun decision and recall its common verb partners: reach a decision, make a decision.
Eliminate arrive and take, which do not collocate with decision in this sense.
Between reach and make, reach fits a group arriving at agreement after discussion, which matches the three-hour meeting.
pembahasan.jebakan: Make a decision is grammatically possible, but the sentence stresses a committee that could not conclude after long discussion, where reach is the standard collocation.
pembahasan.cepat: Learn nouns with their verbs: reach/make a decision, take action, arrive at a conclusion.
